feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 10 September 2026 11:38am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 10 September 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds for a time.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure system near Iceland, bringing frontal zones across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

South 5 or 6 occasionally 7, veering Southwest 4 to 6 this afternoon, then decreasing Westerly 4 or 5 this evening. Further decreasing 3 or 4 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, occasionally rough through the afternoon, falling slight or moderate tonight.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain and drizzle, becoming fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Northwest 3 or 4, backing South or Southwest through the afternoon, then increasing 4 or 5 tomorrow evening, and 5 to 7 overnight into Saturday.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate at first, building moderate occasionally rough later.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain or drizzle spread from the west overnight into Saturday.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle later.
